Stereon benchmark trend

Latest: 7fad9f2 on 2026-11-04, AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor. Hosted runners differ from run to run, so a step in a chart is read against the CPU in its points' titles. The change shown is against the run before; above 10% it is marked.
